rootCause: SLG Windows compute shutdown joins worker threads but overwrites worker, semaphore and completion-event handles without CloseHandle. CSharp already closes each owned kernel handle.
managedDecision: WindowsLlvmRuntimePlatform.cs:1398-1440; wait worker then CloseHandle, after all joins close semaphore and event before clearing globals. CSharp is already correct; no managed implementation change required.
slgDecision: compute_runtime.slg:Windows shutdown lacks all three CloseHandle operations; align existing shutdown only. Linux pthread_join/close path already performs its owned-resource cleanup and stays unchanged.
measurement: Diagnostic-instrumented actual generated LLVM saves first worker/semaphore/event before shutdown, then WaitForSingleObject(saved,0) must return WAIT_FAILED for all closed handles. CSharp exits0, native93, both original stdout14/49/3. Not unmodified-program acceptance or total process handle-count measurement.
